quotes.text: Learn how to accept Alipay payments, a digital wallet popular with customers from China.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: **Supported currencies**: `aud, cad, eur, gbp, hkd, jpy, nzd, sgd, usd, myr`
The Alipay Android SDK doesn’t support test payments. To fully test this integration, use [live mode](https://docs.stripe.com/keys.md#test-live-modes).
The Stripe React Native SDK specifies `safepay/` as the return URL host for bank redirect and digital wallet payment methods.

Use the [client secret](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object.md#payment_intent_object-client_secret) of the `PaymentIntent` and call `stripe.confirmAlipayPayment` to handle the Alipay redirect.

findings: The November 7, 2026 base-URL capture is only a title, purpose and five variant links (new raw lines 1-18). It establishes navigation, not current Checkout, mobile or Direct API behavior. The May 7, 2026 matched capture contains those five full variants (old raw lines 8-1139); the wholesale removal in diff lines 3-1145 is a capture-shape change, not proof of deprecation.

The current source accurately describes many dated old routes but records only the old raw (source lines 4-7, 13-35). Its 'any of 10 supported currencies' wording (source line 19) is too absolute: old Checkout lists ten supported and eleven presentment currencies (old raw lines 20-26), while the mobile/Direct API currency tables condition payments on a bank account and merchant country and separately list CNY (old raw lines 349-367, 885-903, 1121-1139). This is a baseline summary qualification, not a new provider change.

The existing wallet concept lists Alipay Redirect 'No' (wiki/concepts/stripe-wallets.md:12-17), yet its Alipay section says all five paths redirect (lines 307-320), as do the old source and raw (source line 13; old raw lines 18, 909, 1030-1052). Flag reciprocal warning or correction in concept and source context rather than silently treating the November index as new redirect evidence.

Old Checkout supports payment mode but not setup or subscription mode and requires same-currency, one-time line items (old raw lines 28-40, 48-105). Old iOS uses STPPaymentHandler and safepay custom URL return (lines 282-322); Android app-to-app uses PayTask.payV2 and cannot fully test that SDK flow with test payments, while a distinct WebView option uses confirmPayment (lines 439-441, 504-611). React Native uses confirmPayment, custom URL handling and safepay (lines 751-857); Direct API uses PaymentIntent client secret, confirmAlipayPayment and return_url, with optional server-side requires_action/alipay_handle_redirect (lines 924-1093). These claims remain dated.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May 7, 2026 Checkout compatibility, ten supported currencies versus CNY presentment, payment-only mode and same-currency one-time line items: old raw lines 20-40, 48-105.
May 7, 2026 iOS custom URL scheme and safepay return with STPPaymentHandler: old raw lines 240-322; React Native safepay and handleURLCallback plus confirmPayment: lines 751-857.
May 7, 2026 Android Alipay SDK app-to-app flow, live-mode full-test limitation, and separate WebView alternative: old raw lines 439-441, 504-611.
May 7, 2026 Direct API PaymentIntent/confirmAlipayPayment/return_url, optional manual next_action.alipay_handle_redirect, and event-backed fulfillment boundary: old raw lines 924-1099.

Reciprocal warning or scoped correction needed; new index lines 11-18 cannot adjudicate current behavior.

Existing source line 19 says Checkout accepts 'any of 10 supported currencies' without country/account qualification; old Checkout list (old raw lines 22-26) and country/bank-account currency tables in other variants (old raw lines 349-367, 885-903, 1121-1139) need scoped interpretation. CNY is in Checkout presentment but not its supported list.
unresolved_questions: Variant URLs in new raw lines 13-18 were not captured in this job, so present-day integration requirements, eligibility and platform behavior remain unverified.

findings: Add dated November base-URL navigation-only raw provenance while preserving the May detailed capture; qualify source line 19's Checkout currency wording by old raw lines 20-26 and 349-367; scope source line 13's Android test limitation to app-to-app as line 27 already does.
conflicts: The related wallet concept's Redirect No matrix (wiki/concepts/stripe-wallets.md:16) conflicts with source line 13 and old raw lines 18, 1030-1052; coordinate a reciprocal warning or correction without presenting the November index as renewed behavioral authority.
source_assessments.reason: The new capture changes the evidence route and exposes a material baseline qualification; it does not establish a changed Alipay API, platform flow, eligibility or outcome.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/alipay/accept-a-payment, the complete November capture establishes only a title and navigation to Checkout, Direct API, iOS, Android and React Native variants (new raw lines 5-18). It does not establish current payment behavior or prerequisites. The May capture describes single-use authenticated redirects, Checkout payment-only Sessions with same-currency one-time items, server-created PaymentIntents for mobile and Direct API, platform-specific confirmation and return URLs, and webhook/event handling rather than client callback as the reliable business-action boundary (old raw lines 18-40, 48-105, 224-322, 439-441, 504-611, 735-863, 924-1099). A Session, Intent or browser return is not itself proof of successful payment. source-stripe-alipay-accept-payment.md largely summarizes those May paths but its line 19 currency claim needs country/account and CNY presentment qualifications; its date and old raw provenance remain historical.
answers.Q2: The change at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/alipay/accept-a-payment is navigation and capture presentation: new raw lines 9-18 offer variant links where old raw lines 8-1139 held full instructions. No substantive payment-method or API change is established. Retain May-dated Checkout mode and currency constraints, iOS/React Native safepay URL handling, distinct Android app-to-app versus WebView paths and live-mode full-test limitation, and Direct API return_url and requires_action handling (old raw lines 20-40, 282-322, 439-441, 504-611, 751-857, 1029-1099). source-stripe-alipay-accept-payment.md needs new index provenance and a scoped correction of its 'any of 10' wording. The wallet concept's Redirect No row conflicts with the older route evidence and its own redirect paragraph, requiring reciprocal warning; no linked variant was read here, so neither current eligibility nor successful payment can be inferred.
